_readme: Every external endpoint lives here. Items marked verify:true were not reachable from the environment this repo was generated in — confirm on first run.

tigerweb._service_note: {year} is replaced with the ACS year so tract lines match the ACS data. Falls back to fallback_service if that vintage isn't published.

li_parcels.note: NYS ITS Tax Parcel Centroid Points: the statewide assessment roll, one point per property. Used for Nassau/Suffolk walk lists. Only address and building fields are requested — never owner names or mailing addresses. Year built, sq ft and heating fuel are only filled in where the town assessor reports them (parts of Suffolk).

business_licenses.note: NYC DCWP licensed businesses. Only active Premises licenses (a business at a location) are used, never Individual licenses, and only the business category is kept: no names, phone numbers or license numbers.

dac.note: Uses 2010 census tracts. Converted to 2020 tracts via the Census relationship file below. Field names auto-detected when null.

elections.note: 2020 presidential results by voting precinct (official New York precincts), from The New York Times' precinct map, MIT license. Neighborhood-level only: shown on the tract card and as a Target filter. The 2024 version of this map is licensed for non-commercial use only, so it is not used.
elections.credit: The New York Times (The Upshot), presidential precinct map 2020, MIT license; New York results and boundaries by Benjamin Rosenblatt

elections_nyc.note: Official 2024 presidential results by election district from the NYC Board of Elections (ED-level CSV), joined to NYC Planning's election district map by ElectDist = assembly district × 1000 + election district. Public records. Harris = Democratic + Working Families lines; Trump = Republican + Conservative lines; total includes write-ins (Scattered).
elections_nyc.credit: NYC Board of Elections, General Election 2024 results by election district; NYC Department of City Planning election district map

elections_suffolk.note: Official 2024 presidential results by election district from the Suffolk County Board of Elections results file (fixed-width text, archived by OpenElections), joined to Suffolk County's election district map by PRECINCTID (town digit + 3-digit ED). Harris = DEM + WOR, Trump = REP + CON; total includes write-ins. The importer checks the decoded columns against the county totals in the file.
elections_suffolk.credit: Suffolk County Board of Elections, General Election 2024 results by election district (via OpenElections); Suffolk County election district map
